text:
maya: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — observed segmented egress retry spikes (eu-west & na-west) when cross-region failover kicks in. Putting owners and timelines here so we don't lose momentum.

lucas: Ack. I captured the timeline and the rough signal we saw (spike ~1:12-1:22 UTC, 5–10% elevated 5xx retries per region).

raj: I can take playbook edits. Plan: add a 'segmented-egress' runbook section + troubleshooting checklist, and include the packet-capture snippet and curl tests. ETA Wed EOD.

emily: I'll own the routing rule rollout to clip the bad path — will test canary on na-west-2 first.

jin: I'll work on TLS handshake logging enhancement — add SNI + cipher debug logs for handshake failures. Small agent change, ETA Tue morning.

sre-bot: created ticket INC-2234, linked postmortem, and scheduled weekly recurrence monitor for 2w.

maya: Action items (concise):
- raj: playbook edits + verification steps (ETA 2023-06-18)
- emily: canary rollout + rollback criterion (ETA 2023-06-19)
- jin: handshake logging + short-term debug build (ETA 2023-06-17)
- lucas: regression eval across 7-day windows + add alert threshold (ETA 2023-06-20)

lucas: Note on pattern: retries spike only when cross-region egress path uses the fallback NAT path; suspect path MTU or occasional TLS fragment reorder. Repro steps added to ticket.

raj: For playbook, include quick mitigations: 1) route pinning for warm sessions, 2) immediate circuit fallback to local region, 3) temporary increase of TLS handshake timeout for affected regions.

emily: Canary plan:
```
- 5% of traffic na-west-2 -> apply routing fix
- monitor 1h for retry rate, latency, and TLS errors
- abort criteria: +2% retry rate or user-facing error >0.5%
```

maya: Please react with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge ownership. I'll ping for a mid-week sync and update the postmortem doc with these owners.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync on 2023-06-19 14:00 UTC (calendar invite sent)

jin: Acked. Will drop a short patch link here when ready.

raj: Ack — starting playbook draft now, will link PR.

emily: Acked, will post canary results in this thread.

lucas: Putting the evaluation script here for reproducibility:
```
#!/bin/bash
ab -n 10000 -c 50 https://edge-test.example/api/health || true
# parse for 5xx and TLS errors
```

maya: Thanks team — goal is to close postmortem follow-ups within two sprints and ensure this pattern doesn't recur. If anything blocks, flag here and we escalate.
